description: Train horses safely using gradual exercises so they learn tasks and behaviours for riding, racing, or work.

name: Train search dogs
description: Train dogs to search using scent and tracking and to signal clearly when they find a person or item.

name: Assess communication and swallowing impairments
description: Assess how a person speaks, understands and swallows, using questions and simple tests to identify problems.

name: Diagnose speech and language disorders
description: Identify speech or language problems by assessing sounds, understanding and expression, then confirming the type and severity.

name: Assess binocular status and visual acuity
description: Check how well both eyes work together and how clearly a person can see, using standard sight tests.

name: Assess physical condition of clients and patients
description: Assess a person's physical health by checking symptoms, mobility and vital signs to inform care and treatment decisions.

name: Perform ambulatory oxygen assessments
description: Assess whether a patient needs extra oxygen when walking or exercising by measuring oxygen levels and symptoms.

name: Collect biological samples from patients
description: Collect patient samples such as blood, urine or swabs, following hygiene and labelling steps for safe testing.

name: Collect samples or specimens for testing
description: Collect samples such as blood or tissue for laboratory testing, and label and store them to avoid contamination.

name: Conduct drug tests
description: Carry out drug tests on samples such as urine or saliva, following agreed procedures to record accurate results.

name: Take blood samples or donations
description: Take blood from a person safely and hygienically for medical tests or for blood donation.

name: Analyse outputs from cognitive assessments
description: Review cognitive test results against expected ranges to identify strengths and difficulties in memory, attention and thinking.

name: Conduct biomechanical assessments
description: Assess how a person moves and how their joints and muscles work to identify the cause of pain or injury.

name: Conduct clinical neurophysiological assessments
description: Carry out tests that record nerve and muscle signals to help find and diagnose problems in the nervous system.

name: Conduct neurobiology assessments
description: Assess how the brain, spinal cord and nerves are working to help explain symptoms and support a diagnosis.

name: Conduct physical examinations for clinical assessment
description: Examine a patient's body by checking signs such as pulse, breathing, movement and swelling to support diagnosis.

name: Conduct polysomnography
description: Carry out an overnight sleep test that records breathing, heart rate and brain activity to diagnose sleep problems.

name: Conduct psychiatric assessments
description: Assess a patient's mental health through interview and observation to identify mental illness and plan treatment.

name: Conduct psychological assessments
description: Use interviews and standard tests to assess thoughts, feelings and behaviour and to identify needs and support plans.

name: Conduct standardised physical assessments
description: Carry out physical checks using the same method each time to measure and record health or fitness levels.

name: Interview patients to assess health and clinical needs
description: Ask patients questions about symptoms, medical history and concerns to decide what care or tests they need.

name: Perform comprehensive eye tests
description: Test eyesight and eye health by checking vision, eye movements and the inside of the eye for disease.

name: Perform ocular tonometry
description: Measure pressure inside the eye using a tonometer to help identify glaucoma and other pressure-related problems.

name: Use ophthalmic instruments
description: Use eye-care tools, such as an ophthalmoscope, to examine the eye and support treatment.

name: Conduct post-mortems
description: Examine a human body after death to find the cause of death and record medical evidence.

name: Conduct post-mortems on animals
description: Examine an animal's body after death to find the cause of death and record veterinary evidence.

name: Identify cause(s) of death
description: Decide the medical cause of death by reviewing injuries, medical history and test results from the investigation.

name: Perform formal identification of deceased people
description: Confirm a dead person's identity using formal methods such as fingerprints, dental records or personal property checks.

name: Conduct diagnostic ultrasound examinations and assessments
description: Use ultrasound scanning to view organs or a foetus, assess findings and help diagnose medical problems.

name: Interpret ultrasound examination data
description: Review ultrasound images and measurements to recognise normal and abnormal findings that support a diagnosis.

name: Use ultrasonic equipment
description: Use ultrasound equipment to create images or deliver treatment by sending high-frequency sound waves into the body.

name: Conduct hearing tests
description: Carry out hearing tests to measure hearing levels and help identify hearing loss in one or both ears.

name: Conduct immunocytochemistry
description: Use labelled antibodies to stain cells and show where specific proteins or antigens are present under a microscope.

name: Evaluate semen quality
description: Assess semen samples by checking sperm count, movement and shape to help judge male fertility.

name: Operate audiological equipment
description: Use audiology equipment to measure hearing levels and support the fitting and checking of hearing aids.

name: Perform blood tests and analysis
description: Test blood samples by measuring cells, chemicals or proteins to help monitor health and diagnose illness.

name: Perform cerebrospinal fluid analysis
description: Analyse cerebrospinal fluid by checking cell counts, protein and infection markers to help diagnose nervous system disease.

name: Perform diabetic assessments
description: Assess people with diabetes by checking blood glucose, feet, blood pressure and symptoms to spot problems early.

name: Perform diagnostic tests for allergies
description: Carry out allergy tests such as skin prick or blood tests to identify substances that trigger allergic reactions.

name: Perform ECGs (Electrocardiograms)
description: Perform an Electrocardiogram (ECG) to record the heart's electrical activity and help detect rhythm problems.

name: Perform liver kidney function tests
description: Test liver and kidney function by measuring key substances in blood or urine samples.

name: Perform lung function tests
description: Measure how well the lungs move air in and out and how much air they can hold.

name: Perform nuclear medicine procedures
description: Give radioactive tracers and monitor patients during scans or treatments that use radiation to diagnose or treat disease.

name: Perform virological tests
description: Test samples such as blood or swabs to detect viruses and identify the type causing infection.

name: Use specialised otorhinolaryngological instruments
description: Use specialist ear, nose and throat instruments to examine patients and carry out minor treatments safely.

name: Apply radiological health science to medical imaging
description: Apply radiation science to set imaging methods that give clear images while keeping patient radiation dose as low as possible.

name: Conduct pre-treatment imaging
description: Carry out scans before treatment to measure the problem area and help plan the best approach.

name: Manage fluoroscopic procedures
description: Oversee fluoroscopy, which uses live X-ray images, to guide procedures while controlling radiation dose and image quality.

name: Operate diagnostic imaging equipment
description: Operate imaging equipment such as X-ray and Computed Tomography (CT) scanners to produce images for diagnosis.

name: Operate MRI machines
description: Use Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) machines to capture detailed images of the body's internal structures.

name: Perform computed tomographic (CT) examinations
description: Carry out computed tomography (CT) scans to create detailed images of internal body structures for diagnosis.

name: Perform diagnostic video telemetry
description: Record video with linked body measurement signals over time to help diagnose a patient's condition.

name: Perform echocardiograms
description: Conduct ultrasound examinations of the heart to assess its structure and function.

name: Perform mammography
description: Conduct breast imaging using low-dose X-rays to detect early signs of breast cancer.

name: Perform muscle weakness tests
description: Test muscle strength using set movements and resistance to find and record areas of weakness.

name: Test patient nervous system functions
description: Check a patient's nerve function by testing reflexes, sensation, balance and muscle control.

name: Test patient physiological functions
description: Measure key body functions such as breathing, heart rate and blood pressure using clinical tests.

name: Analyse client's dietary habits
description: Review a client's eating habits and nutrient intake to give suitable diet advice.

name: Diagnose dietary issues and treatments
description: Identify nutrition-related problems, such as low iron intake, and recommend diet changes to address them.

name: Identify causes of nutritional imbalance
description: Find causes of nutrition imbalance, such as illness, poor diet choice or absorption problems.

name: Measure nutritional health status of patients
description: Check a patient's nutrition by measuring weight, body mass index, diet history and signs of vitamin or mineral deficiency.

name: Assess drug or alcohol dependency
description: Assess drug or alcohol dependence by asking about use, cravings, withdrawal symptoms, health effects and impact on daily life.

name: Assess healthcare users' risk of harm
description: Identify a person's risk of harm by checking safety, self-neglect, abuse, falls risk and unsafe medicine use.

name: Assess people for mental health issues
description: Assess mental health by asking about mood, anxiety, sleep, thoughts, behaviour changes and how daily life is affected.

name: Assess people with complex health needs
description: Assess complex health needs by reviewing multiple conditions, medicines, symptoms, mobility, support needs and risks.

name: Assess suicidal thoughts
description: Assess suicidal thoughts by asking about intent, plans, access to means, previous attempts and protective factors.

name: Conduct staff health evaluations
description: Assess staff health by taking a health history, checking fitness for work and identifying work-related health risks.

name: Evaluate status of patients
description: Assess a patient's condition by checking symptoms, vital signs, pain, mobility, mental state and test results.

name: Evaluate treatment outcomes
description: Measure treatment outcomes by comparing symptoms, function and test results before and after treatment, and noting side effects.

name: Examine and assess newborns immediately following birth
description: Examine a newborn after birth by checking breathing, colour, heart rate, tone, temperature and obvious physical abnormalities.

name: Identify indicators of problem gambling
description: Recognise signs of problem gambling, such as chasing losses, hiding gambling, or financial and relationship problems.

name: Perform holistic patient-centred assessments
description: Assess a patient's physical and mental health, daily living needs, and preferences to plan appropriate care.

name: Screen and evaluate patients for health risk factors
description: Screen patients for risk factors such as smoking, alcohol use, obesity, and high blood pressure to guide prevention.

name: Triage patients
description: Sort patients by urgency of need for care, using symptoms and vital signs to set treatment priority.

name: Diagnose cancer
description: Diagnose cancer by assessing symptoms and test results, such as scans and biopsies, to confirm malignant disease.

name: Diagnose cardiovascular conditions
description: Diagnose heart and blood vessel conditions using symptoms, examination findings, and tests such as electrocardiograms (ECGs) and blood results.

name: Diagnose ear, nose, and throat conditions
description: Diagnose ear, nose and throat conditions by taking a history, examining the area, and reviewing hearing or imaging tests.

name: Diagnose immunodeficiency conditions
description: Diagnose immune deficiency by reviewing infection history and test results, such as blood counts and antibody levels.

name: Diagnose musculoskeletal disorders
description: Diagnose muscle, bone and joint disorders using symptoms, physical examination, and tests such as X-rays or Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans.

name: Diagnose neurological conditions
description: Diagnose brain and nerve conditions using symptoms, examination findings, and tests such as Computed Tomography (CT) , Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), or nerve studies.

name: Diagnose respiratory conditions
description: Diagnose breathing-related conditions by taking a history, examining the patient, and interpreting relevant test results.

name: Diagnose rheumatic conditions
description: Diagnose rheumatic disease by assessing joint pain and swelling and interpreting blood tests and imaging results.

name: Diagnose tropical illnesses
description: Diagnose tropical illnesses by assessing travel history, symptoms and exposure risks, and interpreting relevant laboratory test results.

name: Recognise and act on contra-indications of treatments
description: Recognise treatment contra-indications, such as allergies or unsafe medicines, and stop or change treatment to avoid harm.

name: Recognise changing signs, symptoms and progression of diseases
description: Recognise changes in symptoms and signs over time and act on worsening disease progression or complications.

name: Recognise patients with acute oral conditions
description: Recognise acute oral conditions, such as severe toothache, swelling or bleeding, that need urgent dental care.

name: Conduct immunisation programmes
description: Run immunisation programmes by planning clinics, giving vaccines safely, and recording consent, doses and follow-up.

name: Implement specific disease outbreak controls in healthcare settings
description: Control disease outbreaks in healthcare settings by isolating cases, using extra cleaning, and following local infection control rules.

name: Maintain infection control in healthcare settings
description: Maintain infection control by following hand hygiene, cleaning and personal protective equipment rules to reduce infection spread.

name: Perform screening for infectious diseases
description: Screen for infectious diseases by collecting samples or measurements, running tests, and recording and reporting results.

name: Provide advice on infectious diseases
description: Give clear advice on preventing, diagnosing and treating infectious diseases to reduce the risk of them spreading.

name: Analyse diagnostic medical images
description: Examine diagnostic medical images to identify disease or injury and assess a patient's condition.

name: Interpret clinical records and notes
description: Read clinical records and notes to understand a patient's history and support safe clinical decisions.

name: Interpret clinical study results
description: Review clinical study results to judge what they show about a treatment's benefits, harms and limits.

name: Interpret diagnostic tests for vascular surgery
description: Interpret test results on blood vessels and blood flow to help plan vascular surgery safely.

name: Interpret electrodiagnostic records
description: Read electrodiagnostic records, such as nerve and muscle electrical tests, to help diagnose nerve disorders.

name: Interpret findings of medical examinations
description: Interpret findings from medical examinations to decide what they suggest and support an accurate diagnosis.

name: Interpret findings of mental health evaluations
description: Interpret mental health evaluation findings to assess symptoms, risks and support appropriate care planning.

name: Interpret urology diagnostic tests
description: Interpret urology test results, such as urine tests and scans, to help diagnose and treat urinary tract problems.

name: Balance efficacy and risks of higher dose levels
description: Judge whether a higher medicine dose is justified by benefits compared with side effects and other risks.

name: Identify and treat adverse drug reactions
description: Recognise harmful or unexpected reactions to medicines and give the right treatment, including stopping or changing the medicine.

name: Monitor and respond to adverse ocular reactions to medications
description: Check for harmful eye symptoms caused by medicines and act promptly, including stopping the medicine and seeking specialist advice.

name: Review and dispense medicine prescriptions
description: Check prescriptions for dose, interactions and suitability, then dispense the correct medicine with clear directions for use.

name: Order medical diagnostic tests
description: Choose and request diagnostic tests that answer a clinical question, and give the lab or service the needed patient details.

name: Prescribe medications
description: Select an appropriate medicine and dose, check for allergies and interactions, and write a legal prescription for the patient.

name: Prescribe mental health support services for patients
description: Assess mental health needs and refer the patient to suitable support services, such as counselling, crisis teams or community care.

name: Prescribe optimal imaging diagnostics
description: Choose and request the safest imaging test for the clinical need, such as X-ray, ultrasound, Computed Tomography (CT) or Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scanning.

name: Prescribe physical therapies or treatments
description: Assess physical function and prescribe suitable therapies, such as exercise programmes, mobilisation, splints or rehabilitation sessions.

name: Prescribe psychological therapies or treatments
description: Assess mental health symptoms and refer the patient for suitable talking therapies, such as Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT).

name: Specify genetic testing plans
description: Plan which genetic tests are needed, explain consent, and set out sample handling and how results will be reported.

name: Use social prescribing
description: Refer people to local non-medical support, such as exercise groups or debt advice, to improve health and wellbeing.

name: Provide advice on end-of-life care
description: Advise patients and families on end-of-life care options, including symptom relief, comfort measures and support services.

name: Provide advice on mental health
description: Advise people on mental health concerns, including ways to reduce risk, recognise symptoms and get treatment.

name: Provide advice on side-effects of health conditions or treatments
description: Explain possible side-effects of a condition or treatment and advise when to seek medical help.

name: Provide pharmaceutical advice and care
description: Advise people on safe medicine use, including doses, interactions, side-effects and follow-up monitoring.

name: Administer anaesthetics to animals
description: Give anaesthetic drugs to animals and monitor them so they stay unconscious and pain-free during procedures.

name: Administer anaesthetics to patients
description: Give anaesthetic drugs and monitor patients to stop pain or cause unconsciousness during medical procedures.

name: Administer local anaesthetics for dental procedures
description: Give a local anaesthetic injection to numb part of the mouth and check it works before treatment.

name: Administer medical gases
description: Give medical gases, such as oxygen or nitrous oxide, and monitor the patient to keep them safe.

name: Administer medication to control pain
description: Give prescribed pain medicine at the correct dose and monitor the patient for pain relief and side-effects.

name: Administer sedation to animals
description: Give sedative medicines to animals to calm them before procedures, and monitor them for side effects.

name: Prepare and maintain anaesthetic equipment
description: Set up, check and maintain anaesthetic machines and breathing circuits so they work safely during procedures.

name: Administer hydrotherapy treatments
description: Treat patients using water-based exercises or pools to reduce pain and improve movement and strength.

name: Administer thermal therapy treatments
description: Apply heat treatments such as hot packs to reduce pain and stiffness and improve blood flow.

name: Develop physiotherapy programmes
description: Design physiotherapy plans with exercises, goals and review dates to help patients recover movement and function.

name: Provide advice on rehabilitation exercises
description: Advise patients on suitable rehabilitation exercises and safe technique to support recovery from injury or illness.

name: Provide advice on the use and benefits of physiotherapy
description: Explain when physiotherapy may help, what it involves, and how it can improve movement and reduce pain.

name: Provide electrotherapeutic treatments
description: Use therapy devices to apply electrical stimulation for pain relief, and check the patient's comfort and response.

name: Treat patients using physiotherapy techniques
description: Treat patients using physiotherapy techniques such as exercises and manual therapy to improve movement and reduce pain.

name: Administer radiation treatments
description: Give prescribed radiotherapy doses by positioning patients correctly and operating equipment safely to target affected tissue.

name: Administer radiopharmaceuticals
description: Prepare and give radiopharmaceutical medicines containing radioactive material to patients for imaging tests or treatment.

name: Evaluate and guide radiation therapy treatment using medical images
description: Use medical images to plan radiotherapy and adjust treatment settings so radiation targets the correct area.

name: Evaluate delivery of radiotherapy
description: Check that radiotherapy is delivered as planned by reviewing patient set-up, treatment records and dose accuracy.

name: Operate heart-lung machines
description: Operate heart-lung machines during surgery to temporarily replace heart and lung function and maintain blood oxygen levels.

name: Operate lifesaving equipment at sea
description: Operate life-saving equipment at sea, such as life rafts, lifejackets and distress beacons, during emergencies.

name: Use defibrillators
description: Operate defibrillators to deliver electrical shocks to the heart in order to restore normal rhythm during cardiac emergencies.

name: Harvest eggs from patients
description: Collect eggs from a patient's ovaries using clinical procedures for fertility treatment or other reproductive care.

name: Manage semen storage and thawing
description: Store and thaw semen samples safely by following approved temperatures, timing and handling steps for fertility treatment.

name: Transfer and remove embryos
description: Transfer embryos into the uterus during fertility treatment, or remove embryos from storage for testing or disposal.

name: Perform cardiovascular procedures
description: Carry out heart and blood vessel procedures, such as catheter tests or vessel repair, to diagnose or treat disease.

name: Perform vascular surgery
description: Carry out operations to repair or replace blood vessels, such as arteries and veins, to restore blood flow.

name: Perform chiropractic assessments and diagnoses
description: Check a patient's spine, joints and movement to identify the cause of muscle, bone or nerve pain.

name: Perform chiropractic treatments
description: Treat pain and stiffness by using hands-on techniques to adjust the spine and joints and improve movement.

name: Apply tooth-coloured materials to crowns and bridges
description: Apply tooth-coloured material to crowns and bridges, which are fixed covers or replacements for missing teeth.

name: Assist dentists during dental procedures
description: Assist the dentist by preparing instruments, passing equipment, and helping to keep the patient comfortable and safe.

name: Correct dentofacial deformities and malocclusion
description: Correct problems with jaw and facial growth and misaligned teeth, using braces, surgery or other dental treatment.

name: Diagnose dental abnormalities and conditions
description: Examine teeth and gums to identify problems such as decay, infection, gum disease, damage or unusual growth.

name: Fit and adjust dental or orthodontic appliances
description: Fit and adjust appliances such as braces, retainers or dentures so they sit comfortably and work correctly.

name: Perform dental examinations
description: Examine a patient's mouth, teeth and gums to spot signs of decay, gum disease, infection or oral cancer.

name: Perform orthodontic screening
description: Check tooth and jaw alignment to identify problems such as crowding or bite issues and decide on referral.

name: Polish dental prostheses or restorations
description: Polish dental prostheses or restorations to make surfaces smooth, improve appearance and help ensure a comfortable fit.

name: Provide periodontal treatment
description: Treat gum disease by cleaning below the gum line and managing infection in the tissues supporting the teeth.

name: Restore teeths' natural colour
description: Restore the natural colour of teeth by removing stains or using bleaching treatments to lighten discolouration safely.

name: Select materials and equipment for orthodontic care
description: Select suitable orthodontic materials and equipment, such as braces parts and wires, for the planned tooth movement.

name: Treat dental cavities
description: Provide dental treatment to remove decay and fill cavities in teeth.

name: Use dental impressions to produce study models
description: Use dental impressions to make accurate study models for assessing teeth and planning dental treatment.

name: Perform cataract surgery
description: Remove a cataract from the eye using surgery, usually replacing the cloudy lens with an artificial lens.

name: Perform eye surgery
description: Carry out surgery on the eye to correct vision or treat conditions such as glaucoma, retinal tears or cataracts.

name: Perform orthoptic procedures
description: Assess and treat squints and double vision using eye movement tests and prescribed eye exercises.

name: Administer fluids or blood intravenously
description: Give fluids or blood into a vein through an intravenous line as part of a patient's treatment.

name: Administer intravenous medications or immunisations
description: Give medicine or an immunisation by injecting it directly into a patient's vein.

name: Perform haemostasis procedures
description: Carry out actions such as applying pressure or using clamps to stop bleeding and help blood clot.

name: Perform IV cannulation
description: Insert a small tube into a vein to give fluids or medicines into the bloodstream.

name: Perform urinary catheterisation
description: Insert and care for a urinary catheter to drain urine from the bladder into a collection bag.

name: Perform venepuncture procedures
description: Insert a needle into a vein to take a blood sample or give treatment into the bloodstream.

name: Perform biopsies
description: Remove a small sample of tissue from a patient so it can be checked for disease.

name: Perform bronchoscopies
description: Examine the airways using a thin flexible tube with a camera to find or treat breathing problems.

name: Perform caesarean sections
description: Deliver a baby by surgery, making cuts in the mother's abdomen and womb.

name: Perform cosmetic surgery
description: Carry out surgery such as nose reshaping or breast surgery to change or improve a person's appearance.

name: Perform endoscopies
description: Examine inside an organ or body cavity using a thin flexible tube with a camera to find disease.

name: Perform hernia surgery
description: Carry out surgery to repair a hernia, where tissue pushes through a weak area in muscle.

name: Perform oesophagoscopies
description: Examine the oesophagus using a thin flexible tube with a camera to find or assess problems.

name: Perform robotic surgery
description: Carry out surgery using computer-controlled robotic instruments that the surgeon operates from a console.

name: Perform stem cell and bone marrow transplants
description: Replace a patient's bone marrow by giving healthy stem cells through a drip into a vein.

name: Apply foot casts
description: Apply a cast to a patient's foot to keep it still and protect a broken bone or injury.

name: Perform orthopaedic examinations
description: Check joints, bones and muscles by asking questions and doing simple tests to identify problems.

name: Perform orthopaedic surgery
description: Carry out surgery on bones, joints or muscles to repair fractures, joint damage or deformities.

name: Treat acute injuries to bones, joints, ligaments, and tendons
description: Assess and treat sudden injuries to bones, joints, ligaments and tendons using immobilisation, pain relief or referral.

name: Administer laser treatments of skin conditions
description: Use a medical laser to treat skin conditions by targeting damaged tissue or unwanted blood vessels.

name: Administer photodynamic treatments for cancer
description: Treat cancer using photodynamic therapy, where a light-sensitive drug is activated by light to kill cells.

name: Apply supports for spinal adjustment
description: Fit and adjust supports such as pillows, blocks or straps to position the spine safely during treatment.

name: Perform acupuncture therapies
description: Insert fine needles at selected points on the body to help relieve pain or other symptoms.

name: Perform deep tissue massages
description: Use firm pressure and slow strokes to work on deeper muscle and connective tissue beneath the skin.

name: Perform holistic massages
description: Give a massage that adapts pressure and technique to the person's physical needs and comfort.

name: Provide foot treatments
description: Treat common foot problems by cleaning, trimming and caring for nails and skin, and removing hard skin.

name: Provide neuromusculoskeletal therapy sessions
description: Assess nerve and joint problems, then use hands-on treatment and exercises to reduce pain and improve movement.

name: Assess injuries in emergency situations
description: Check injuries in an emergency to judge how serious they are and what immediate care is needed.

name: Manage burns and scalds in emergency situations
description: Give first aid for burns and scalds by cooling the area, protecting the wound, and monitoring for shock.

name: Provide first aid
description: Give immediate care such as checking breathing, controlling bleeding and treating shock until help arrives.

name: Provide stabilisation care to patients
description: Support airway, breathing and circulation to keep a critically ill patient stable until further treatment is available.

name: Provide tracheostomy care
description: Care for a person with a tracheostomy by cleaning the tube, checking airflow, and watching for infection.

name: Treat wounds and bleeding
description: Treat cuts and bleeding by cleaning the wound, stopping blood loss, dressing it, and checking healing.

name: Administer immunotherapy
description: Give immunotherapy medicines, such as allergy injections or cancer drugs, while checking for side effects.

name: Treat glandular disorders
description: Treat gland problems by assessing symptoms, ordering tests, and giving medicines to restore normal gland function.

name: Treat hormonal disorders
description: Treat hormone disorders by checking hormone levels and giving medicines to correct overproduction or underproduction.

name: Work within multidisciplinary healthcare teams
description: Work with different healthcare staff by sharing patient information, agreeing care plans, and handing over safely.

name: Adapt therapeutic environments to meet service users' requirements
description: Change the therapy space to meet service user needs, such as lighting, noise levels, seating and privacy.

name: Administer psychological treatments
description: Deliver agreed talking therapies or behaviour treatments, monitor progress and risks, and adjust plans under clinical guidance.

name: Administer transcranial magnetic stimulation
description: Deliver transcranial magnetic stimulation by placing a magnetic coil on the scalp and giving timed pulses safely.

name: Care for patients with mental illnesses
description: Support people with mental illness by assessing risk, providing day-to-day care, and helping them access treatment.

name: Develop psychological treatment programmes
description: Create and review treatment plans that set therapy goals, session content and measures to track progress over time.

name: Develop therapeutic relationships with patients
description: Build a supportive working relationship by listening, agreeing boundaries, showing respect and encouraging patients to take part in treatment.

name: Manage acute psychiatric emergencies
description: Respond to urgent mental health crises by assessing risk, calming the person, arranging medical help and keeping others safe.

name: Organise psychosocial intervention group work
description: Plan and run support groups that use guided discussion and activities to help people manage social and emotional problems.

name: Provide art therapy sessions
description: Lead art-based therapy sessions where clients create images to explore feelings, then discuss the work to support wellbeing.

name: Provide Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) sessions
description: Deliver Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) sessions to help clients spot unhelpful thoughts and practise new behaviours.

name: Provide psychological and emotional support to patients
description: Support patients by listening without judgement, giving reassurance, explaining coping strategies and signposting further help when needed.

name: Provide psychological support in crisis situations
description: Give immediate emotional support in a crisis by listening, checking safety, helping the person calm down and arranging follow-up care.

name: Provide psychotherapeutic sessions
description: Provide talking therapy sessions that help clients understand their feelings, explore causes of distress and plan changes in daily life.

name: Support people with mental health issues
description: Help people with mental health problems by discussing needs, encouraging self-care, supporting daily routines and linking to services.

name: Conduct genetic assessments and counselling
description: Review inherited health information, explain possible risks, and help people understand testing and family planning choices.

name: Counsel people with substance misuse issues
description: Give counselling to help people reduce or stop harmful drug or alcohol use and prevent relapse.

name: Evaluate needs of abuse victims
description: Identify an abuse victim's safety, health, housing and legal support needs to plan suitable help.

name: Provide advice to assault survivors on protective measures
description: Advise assault survivors on safety planning, reporting options and support services to reduce the risk of further harm.

name: Provide anger management counselling
description: Teach people ways to recognise anger triggers and use coping techniques to respond without aggression.

name: Provide spiritual support and counselling
description: Provide faith-based listening and guidance to help people cope with illness, loss or other personal difficulties.

name: Support people affected by pregnancy loss
description: Support people after pregnancy loss by listening, explaining care options, and helping them access bereavement services.

name: Support survivors of sexual violence
description: Support sexual violence survivors by listening, helping with safety planning, and linking them to health and police services.

name: Support traumatised people
description: Support traumatised people by listening without judgement, encouraging coping skills, and referring them for specialist help if needed.

name: Support young victims of sexual abuse
description: Support children and young people after sexual abuse by listening, protecting their safety, and arranging specialist services.

name: Assess risks for visually impaired and deafblind people
description: Identify hazards and safety risks for people with sight loss or deafblindness at home, work or in public.

name: Identify causes and implications of sensory impairments
description: Identify causes of sight or hearing loss and explain how it affects daily activities, safety and communication.

name: Provide vision rehabilitation and treatment
description: Provide vision rehabilitation, exercises and treatments to help people manage sight loss and improve daily functioning.

name: Support stroke rehabilitation
description: Support stroke recovery by helping with exercise plans, daily tasks and communication during rehabilitation sessions.

name: Provide acute nursing care
description: Provide urgent nursing care for sudden or severe illness by monitoring patients and giving treatments as prescribed.

name: Provide long-term nursing care
description: Provide long-term nursing care by managing symptoms, medicines and personal care for people with ongoing conditions.

name: Provide nursing care in community settings
description: Provide nursing care in people's homes, clinics or care homes, including checks, wound care and health advice.

name: Monitor patients during surgery
description: Monitor patients' vital signs during surgery and report or act on changes to keep them safe.

name: Monitor patients during treatments or procedures
description: Monitor patients during treatments or procedures by checking vital signs, comfort and side effects, and reporting concerns.

name: Perform foetal monitoring
description: Monitor a foetus's heart rate and wellbeing during pregnancy or labour using standard clinical monitoring equipment.

name: Prepare patients physically for medical procedures
description: Prepare patients for procedures by positioning them, cleaning skin, and checking fasting, consent, and observations.

name: Care for women during labour and birth
description: Care for women in labour by monitoring progress, managing pain, giving reassurance, and responding to complications.

name: Care for women during pregnancy
description: Care for pregnant women by checking physical health, discussing symptoms, giving advice, and spotting signs of risk.

name: Evaluate postnatal health and well-being of women
description: Assess a woman after birth by checking bleeding, pain, temperature, mood, and recovery, and arranging further care.

name: Provide abortion care
description: Provide abortion care by explaining options, checking health, giving treatment, managing pain, and arranging follow-up support.

name: Provide postnatal care
description: Provide postnatal care by checking mother and baby health, supporting feeding, and giving safety and self-care advice.

name: Assess baby feeding

description: Clean and disinfect food preparation surfaces, equipment and utensils to prevent contamination and food poisoning.

name: Clean homes
description: Clean homes by dusting, vacuuming, mopping and wiping surfaces to keep rooms tidy and hygienic.

name: Clean manufacturing environments
description: Clean factory floors, work areas and machinery exteriors to reduce contamination risks and prevent slips and trips.

name: Clean medical facilities
description: Clean and disinfect wards, clinics and treatment rooms to reduce infection spread between patients and staff.

name: Clean offices
description: Clean offices by emptying bins, vacuuming, dusting and wiping desks and shared areas to keep them hygienic.

name: Clean windows
description: Wash and polish windows inside and outside buildings to remove dirt, smears and water marks.

name: Perform pressure washing
description: Use high-pressure water jets to clean patios, walls and driveways by removing dirt, moss and grime.

name: Service rooms
description: Clean guest rooms by changing bedding, cleaning bathrooms, restocking supplies and checking the room is ready.

name: Decontaminate equipment of dangerous substances
description: Remove dangerous substances from equipment using suitable cleaning methods and controls to prevent people being exposed.

name: Maintain and prepare dental instruments
description: Clean, sterilise, check and store dental instruments so they are safe, complete and ready for treatment.

name: Sterilise food processing equipment
description: Clean and disinfect food processing equipment to remove dirt and germs and reduce the risk of food poisoning.

name: Sterilise medical equipment or instruments
description: Clean and disinfect medical instruments so they are free from germs and safe to use on patients.

name: Apply preservation treatments
description: Apply treatments such as drying, sealing or chemical cleaning to slow damage to materials or artefacts.

name: Prepare materials for preservation or storage
description: Clean, label and pack items using suitable materials so they can be stored safely for a long time.

name: Restore historical artefacts
description: Repair and stabilise damaged artefacts using careful cleaning and mending to prevent further deterioration over time.

name: Restore natural environment post-drilling
description: Restore land after drilling by removing waste, reshaping ground and replanting vegetation to support wildlife recovery.

name: Treat flood damage
description: Dry, clean and repair flood-damaged buildings by removing water, drying materials and replacing damaged fixtures.

name: Design infestation treatment plans
description: Create a step-by-step plan to identify pests and choose safe, effective treatments to remove them.

name: Treat premises to eliminate pests
description: Treat premises using approved pest control methods to remove pests while following health and safety rules.
